name: FreshBooks
summary: Accounting and invoicing for small businesses.

flows.title: Create a client
steps: Stop and tell the person, and change nothing, if FreshBooks says the plan has no room for more clients. Never change the plan to make room.
Go to the Clients section and select the New Client button, or on the Dashboard select Create New, then Client.
Enter the First Name and Last Name, or the Company name; one of the two is required.
If needed, enter the Email Address and Phone Number, and select Add Address to choose a Country and enter the street, city, state and zip code.
Leave the Client Settings below those fields as they are, and select Save.
stops: upgrading the plan to make room for more clients

flows.title: Import clients from a CSV file
steps: Stop and tell the person, and change nothing, if FreshBooks says the plan has no room for all the clients in the file. Never change the plan to make room.

Prepare a CSV file whose headers include First Name and Last Name, or Company Name, or all three. Email Address, Phone Number, the address lines, City, State, Zip Code and Country are optional headers.
Go to the Clients section, select the More Actions button, then Import Clients.
Select Choose File and pick the CSV, match the First Name and other fields to the file's columns using the dropdowns, and select Continue.
Match any optional address fields, then select Import Clients. Every row is imported, duplicates included, so check the file for clients already in FreshBooks first.
stops: upgrading the plan to make room for the clients in the file
